title: Supported scalar tensor interval and reflection to an arbitrary etale origin
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a unital map $A\to B$ of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, schemes $U,Z$, an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$, and integers $a\leq b$. Work with constant-ring module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites and ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived categories with comparison $\nu_Z^*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $M\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ have Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. With pro-etale extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero] put
$$N=j_!^{\mathrm{pro},A}M,\quad Q=M\otimes^L_{A_U}B_U,\quad M_B=T_U^{A,B}M,$$
where $Q$ retains only its $A$-action, derived tensor on the pro-etale sites is [def-weil-derived-tensor], and $T_U^{A,B}$ is scalar extension with its $B$-action [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]. Let $\operatorname{Res}_{A\to B}$ denote restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. There are canonical isomorphisms in $D(Z_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$
$$N\otimes^L_{A_Z}B_Z\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!^{\mathrm{pro},A}Q\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_{A\to B}j_!^{\mathrm{pro},B}M_B.$$
The first is the open projection comparison using $j^{-1}B_Z=B_U$. The second is induced by the identity on the K-flat tensor complex computing $Q\cong\operatorname{Res}_{A\to B}M_B$, followed by the restriction-of-scalars comparison for extension by zero. Each displayed object and $Q$ has cohomology zero outside $[a,b]$. Moreover, for every etale $A$-complex $E\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and every isomorphism
$$r:\nu_Z^*E\xrightarrow{\sim}N\otimes^L_{A_Z}B_Z,$$
one has $\mathcal H^q(E)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$. No boundedness, constructibility, or prior etale-origin hypothesis on $M$ or $E$, and no flatness or finite projective dimension of $B$ over $A$, is required beyond the stated Tor interval of $M$.

proof.text: Choose a cochain representative L of M and a flat-term K-flat resolution P → L using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. The scalarMateDerivedTensorIso of [def-sp-proetale-scalar-mate-identifications] identifies tensor φ U aU M with restriction of scalar extension. The K-flat computation of [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor], the exact restriction localization factor, and scalarMateOrdinaryComplexIso identify this with Q(Tot(P tensor B_U[0])). This is exactly the tensor tested by [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], so its cohomology vanishes outside [a,b]. No flatness of B is used.

Specialize [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data] to the constant A family. The inverse projection is invertible by [lem-sp-intrinsic-open-projection-invertible], so openProjectionIso is an isomorphism. The normalized scalarMateDerivedCoefficientPullback of [def-sp-proetale-scalar-mate-identifications] identifies pullback of B_Z[0] with B_U[0]. Tensoring its hom with the identity of M and applying open extension preserves invertibility. Their composite is definitionally projection.

proof.text: The inverse of scalarMateDerivedTensorIso from [def-sp-proetale-scalar-mate-identifications] identifies the tensor on U with the restricted scalar extension. Apply exact open extension and compose with openRestriction from [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], specialized to change φ. Both factors are isomorphisms; this composite is definitionally restrictionComparison. No constructibility clause of scalar extension is used.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change, computation on K-flat complexes; sites-modules.tex Tag 03DJ, lemma-extension-by-zero-exact, and the coefficient-restriction comparison

proof.text: The open extension of [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data] is an exact module functor, and its derived functor is definitionally openExtension j. Apply the cohomology commutation of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below], as implemented by Functor.isZero_homologyFunctor_mapDerivedCategory_obj, to Step 1. This proves vanishing for the open extension of the tensor on U. Map the isomorphisms of Steps 2 and 3 through the homology functor and transport this zero-object property to the ambient tensor and the restricted B-extension.

source.place: Tag 03DJ, lemma-extension-by-zero-exact; passage to cohomology for an exact degreewise functor

proof.text: For E and r as in the statement, Step 4 and r give zero homology for its intrinsic derived comparison pullback. The intrinsic realization of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] is an exact equivalence. The comparison on fixed-coefficient module sheaves is faithful by [det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules], hence their composite finiteCoefficientIntrinsicComparison is faithful and exact. Its derived functor is definitionally finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison. Apply the generic cohomology commutation of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below]: the image of H^q(E) is zero, so faithfulness equates its identity and zero morphisms. Functor.isZero_homologyFunctor_of_isZero_homologyFunctor_mapDerivedCategory_obj performs this argument. It applies degree by degree without boundedness of E or derived full faithfulness.

lean.statement: theorem supported_scalar_tor_interval {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (_hA : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : A, (ℓ ^ n) • x = 0) (_hB : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : B, (ℓ ^ n) • x = 0) (φ : A →+* B) {U Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a b : ℤ) (_hab : a ≤ b) (aU : ProEtaleTensorModel U (proEtaleConstantRing U A)) (aZ : ProEtaleTensorModel Z (proEtaleConstantRing Z A)) (M : proEtaleDerivedCategory U A) (_hTor : HasProEtaleTorAmplitude U A M a b) : IsIso (projection φ j aU aZ M) ∧ IsIso (restrictionComparison φ j aU M) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (tensor φ U aU M)) ∧ IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (tensor φ Z aZ ((openExtension (A := A) j).obj M))) ∧ IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((openExtension (A := A) j).obj (tensor φ U aU M))) ∧ IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((scalarRestriction φ Z).obj ((openExtension (A := B) j).obj ((scalarExtensionFunctor φ U).obj M))))) ∧ (∀ E : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) Z, ∀ _r : (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).obj E ≅ tensor φ Z aZ ((openExtension (A := A) j).obj M), ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj E))
